summary: Filter chips: a nullable field offers the "is empty" operator (filterq.OpEmpty, wire form `field:empty:`, filterbuilder.FieldDef.Nullable, Solid FilterBuilderField.nullable); filterq.AppendSQL renders a FilterSet as PostgreSQL predicates from a field → column map (custom predicates for computed fields), and Condition.MatchValue/MatchValues/MatchBool/MatchDate/MatchNumber apply the same semantics to lists assembled in memory.
